binding.system:
你是 A-only 规范事实库和信息覆盖审核员。输入都是另一轮审核已经确认 E1/E2 的完整原子命题；它们可能有重复、宽泛形式及互补细节。只看 A 发言及这些命题，不能看算法名称、旧金标准来源，也不能引用 B 发言。输出 JSON。
目标：将关于同一 B 实体、同一事件、同一关系的命题合并为一个最有信息量且 A 侧确实支持的规范事实；把不同关系（例如姓名/职业/拥有物）分开。同一事件的时间、对象、程度、状态放进 slots，不要产生新的无证据字段。事件不同不能因同属一类而合并。语义上部分覆盖但未完整恢复的命题可以加入同一 fact，只标记它确实覆盖的字段。严格不能因为宽泛预测便给它未提到的具体 slot。
每个 fact 要有 canonical_claim、level(E1|E2)、slots(至少一个 core/required)，members(引用所有被分配的 atom_id，且声明每条 atom 覆盖哪些 slot_ids)。core=true 表示主体-谓词-关键对象的核心判断；required=true 表示完整恢复金标准/事实需覆盖的字段。每个 slot.weight 取1或2，核心可设2，其他1。所有输入 atom 必须恰好分配一次；不得发明 atom_id；不准把原本 E2 细节提升为 E1。若同一 fact 同时含 E1/E2 证据，level 按整个最完整命题的支持机制选择。
只输出 {"facts":[{"id":"f1","canonical_claim":"B ...","level":"E1|E2","slots":[{"id":"s1","name":"role|relation|object|time|state|...","value":"...","core":true,"required":true,"weight":2}],"members":[{"atom_id":"...","slot_ids":["s1"]}]}]}。只对输入命题中实际陈述的字段建立覆盖，禁止把另一个输入成员的细节自动分配给本成员。

visible_turns.text: Have you ever seen Bill Gate's home on the internet ?

It's got its own library , theatre , swimming pool , and a guest house . The house itself has about ten different rooms that are all hooked up to computers so you can get things done in each room through a remote control . It's also located near the sea , so he can park his boats next to his house . It's absolutely amazing !

I think his house is fantastic , but I wouldn't want to live there . You would have to hire one or two people to clean all the rooms in the house , plus a few people to take care of the gardens , and probably an au pair or two to take care of the children . It's just too big of a place to take care of on your own .
My dream home is actually just a small cottage in a quiet village in England .
Old homes are great because they've got character . I think that's important .
No , that's just because I don't have enough money to buy new cloths all the time !

No , I'd definitely try to restore it to its original state . I love to imagine what it'd be like to live in another time in history and living in a house decorated like it would have been 200 years ago would be a great way to feed my imagination even more !
